 Coventry 2-2 Crystal Palace

 Post published at 16:27 GMT 16:27 GMT 
 Tottenham 2-0 Ipswich 
 Great save from Ipswich keeper Christian Walton who does really well to readjust, diving to his right to keep out a Conor Gallagher cross which deflects goalwards off defender Dara O'Shea.
 A Spurs third feels far more likely than an Ipswich first.

 Bournemouth 2-0 Forest 
 Justin Kluivert, having passed up the chance to shoot a couple of minutes ago, does have a first time go from 18 yards this time and stings the palms of Matz Sels.
 Bournemouth are getting closer to a third goal.

 Aston Villa 0-0 Sunderland 
 The substitutes combine as Ibrahim Mbaye tees it up for John McGinn but the Villa skipper is leaning back and he sweeps it over the top. 
 Got to be doing better there.
